payload.objective: Submit Phase 4 Attainment Engine, SBTE Bulk Import & Carmie AI report and request Phase 5 Final Closeout Dispatch.
payload.explicit_request: Phase 4 Attainment Engine, SBTE Import & Carmie AI is complete with all tests passing (171 tests, 992 assertions). Please evaluate and issue TASK_DISPATCH for Phase 5 (Route Harmonization & Final Closeout).

task_report.summary: HOD Program Attainment forwarders created; SBTE PDF parser and modal forwarder restored; carmie_query_model.json synced; queryGemini added to CarmieAssistantController; 171 tests passing with 992 assertions.

payload.reason: Phase 4 is approved as complete. The reported HOD Program Attainment implementation preserves the modernized dashboard and report architecture, the SBTE attendance import restores the missing parser and compatibility entry point, and the Carmie reconciliation restores the audited query model and Gemini integration. The report also confirms dedicated tests passed and the full regression suite remains at 171 tests, 992 assertions, with zero failures. Phase 5 is therefore authorized as the final closeout stage. The final audit must verify route parity against the backwards forensic matrix, distinguish genuinely missing functionality from intentionally deferred or already-replaced routes, confirm that no duplicate route registrations or dead legacy endpoints were introduced, and verify the complete Wave 6 implementation through the full regression suite. Closeout should not be declared merely from the existing PHPUnit pass; it requires final route reconciliation and confirmation that all audited gaps are either restored, intentionally deferred with an existing migration-state record, or explicitly replaced by the modern CampusLynk architecture.
